invoke_agent_a2a: invoke an agent using the A2A protocol with JSON-RPC 2.0 message/send or message/stream methods
get_agent_card: get the agent card for an agent via A2A discovery endpoint at .well-known/agent-card.json
handle_stream_message: handle streaming A2A message responses with NDJSON output and proxy hook support
get_agent: look up an agent by ID or name from the global agent registry
jsonrpc_error: create a JSON-RPC 2.0 error response with code, message, and status code
